---
title: "Differential model"
output: html_document
params:
  out_dir:
    value: "results"
  alpha: 0.05
---

```{r setup}
# knitr runs in the folder of this Rmd, hence the "..".
source("utils.R")
clean <- readRDS(file.path("..", params$out_dir, "clean.rds"))
```

```{r model}
fit <- glm(count ~ condition, data = clean, family = poisson)
saveRDS(fit, file.path("..", params$out_dir, "model.rds"))
de <- broom::tidy(fit)
save_table(de, "de_table")
```
